issues.problem: The hover row is computed as `(mouseY - topPos - 35) / 15`. Java integer division truncates toward zero, so mouseY values 1–14 px above the list (the sort, reverse and page controls at y 18–32) give row 0. The first candidate's detail tooltip then covers those controls.
issues.reason: A tooltip appears where no candidate is hovered and hides the buttons, so the tooltip display does not match the real state.
issues.fix: Check `mouseY >= topPos + 35` before dividing, or use Math.floorDiv.

issues.problem: broadcastChanges rebuilds and sorts the full closure candidate list on every tick for every viewer. Inside the stream it calls pan.bannedCandidates(), which copies the set once per entry. Changes are detected through a 31-multiplier long hash (contentHash), so a hash collision silently skips a needed update.
issues.reason: This costs O(n log n + n·b) every server tick per open PAN screen, and a collision can leave the client page out of sync with the server.
issues.fix: Rebuild the sorted list only when the display closure, ban set, sort or order changes. Read the banned set once (or use contains on the field directly). Compare the new SnapshotPayload with the last sent one using record equals instead of a hand-made hash, and remove contentHash.

history.note: fixed: Cached PAN candidates until their inputs change and compared snapshot records directly.
Sorted candidates are cached by closure, sort, order and ban version; the banned set is read once; snapshot compared by record equals; contentHash removed.

issues.problem: The scenario does no real two-client operation. The second client only opens the chest when one is available and does nothing else; nothing runs when only one client exists, and nothing compares the two views. There is no disconnect/reconnect step. clickWidget returns false without failing, so missing buttons go unnoticed. Settings are reopened and checked only for PAN, not for the trader selection, area settings or filter.
issues.reason: AC-F046-003 requires 2-client operation, scrolling, updates and reconnects with displays matching the server state. AC-F046-002 requires settings and selections to be correct after close and reopen.
issues.fix: Require two clients and have both operate the same PAN, chest, trader and area machine. Add a reconnect step and capture after it. Fail when an expected widget is missing. Reopen and capture the trader, area machine, filter and chest after changing their settings.
